reviewScope.summary: Scoped review of onboarding programme/avatar selected states, responsive category-based shared Settings, backup/cloud/reset grouping, Guild account deep links and RPG HUD identity/status alignment. No database, provider, release controls, dependencies or destructive action handlers were changed.
evidence: Source-only read of current master and branch components, styling, affected callers, routing and documented release constraints.
Isolated branch based on master 747d80e284eceda2d18c74c99c15735a021ffbfb; compare view before binding shows 31 changed files and no base divergence.
Settings remain in one shared SettingsSurface for Classic/RPG; search parameter selects visible panel without unmounting profile/backup state.
Added and adapted focused Vitest and Playwright tests for Settings category routing, draft preservation, recovery, coordination, cloud account, theme, programme and Activity.
No local Node 24/npm 11 or browser test execution was available in this session. GitHub-hosted Final candidate certification is required and its result must be observed before merge.
Prettier failure on first hosted PR check 43347218150 was limited to seven source/test files; targeted formatting corrections were applied and require revalidation on the new head.

adversarialFindings.description: Selected programme and avatar options were visually confusable with unselected choices.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Full-card checked border/fill/indicator, visible Selected label for programme, shared focus outline and responsive option grids.

adversarialFindings.description: Hiding unrelated Settings panels could disconnect direct Guild account links or discard in-progress form state.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use same-route URL query categories, preserve mounted subtrees, update Guild account links to data category and add draft-persistence coverage.

adversarialFindings.description: Moving cloud and restore panels risks accidental operation of destructive controls.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Preserved existing restore preview, confirmation, writer-lock and RESET handlers; reset stays a full-width separate section, not adjacent to cloud activation.

adversarialFindings.description: Changes have not been compiled, formatted or exercised in Chromium by the implementer environment.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted for draft PR only; required hosted release validation must pass on the final reviewed payload before any merge or production promotion. Failed gate blocks merge.

retrospective.summary: Proceed to draft PR and hosted exact-candidate certification; not approval to merge without successful checks. Prefer scoped reuse of existing components, functional tests and theme tokens; preserve user data semantics.
